dominion.of.canada.unoffical: Pavel Unoffical reached S-C9 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-C9, Pavel Unoffical listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Pavel Unoffical ran six messages in one night. The last one was a request for more runners. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Pavel Unoffical is number 648. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-C9. Pavel Unoffical has learned to walk bent double.
galactic_racoon: On Day 11 Ivo Racoon took a post at U-F3 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He shares cigarettes but never smokes, and the men liked him for it. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Ivo Racoon could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
imerv2: On Day 8 Isidor "Saint" Imerv took a post at R-S17 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He hums hymns when frightened, and the men liked him for it.
Casimir Nile and Isidor "Saint" Imerv argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.

Isidor "Saint" Imerv was carrying water up to R-S17 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Isidor "Saint" Imerv did not. Shot by Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor of the Hegemony (@andyincorporated). Isidor "Saint" Imerv smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil came out for a cup and was gravely wounded. Isidor "Saint" Imerv was hit at R-S17 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor of the Hegemony (@andyincorporated).
The papers connected Jakub "Bones" Imerv to Isidor "Saint" Imerv. The men took longer to learn Jakub "Bones" Imerv's own habits, but they made the effort.

Jakub "Bones" Imerv was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S17. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Gideon Jesh of the Hegemony (@jesh20000). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Jakub "Bones" Imerv answered to number 594. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Jakub "Bones" Imerv watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
jarbeefus_kong: Casimir Kong, a lamplighter from Halden, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in T-F10. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Casimir Kong was hit in the hip at T-F10. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Pavel Volna of the Concord (@vonya_volna). Casimir Kong looked over the parapet at T-F10 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Pavel Volna of the Concord (@vonya_volna).

Bram "Mole" Kong asked about Casimir Kong on arriving at T-F10. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Bram "Mole" Kong helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
joseph_austin15_: Emil "Spark" Austin arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Emil "Spark" Austin watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Emil "Spark" Austin held the mirror while Cyril "Mud" Sann shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. Emil "Spark" Austin got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 643. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Emil "Spark" Austin wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
oliversheppard1: Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa found a place in T-S7 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa carried three men out of T-S7 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
